description: Source-of-truth checklist template for vault migration readiness. The server evaluates each gate against deterministic evidence (registry, yields, share-price history, backend health) and the client renders the result. This file must stay machine-readable and drift-free.

gates.title: Vault contract registered
gates.description: The vault contract address is present in contracts/registry.json for the active network.
gates.guidance: Deploy the vault contract and record its 56-character Soroban address under 'vault' for the target network.

gates.title: Yield feed live
gates.description: The yields feed publishes a non-stale APY/TVL entry for the vault's protocol and asset.
gates.guidance: Confirm the underlying provider is reachable and that the protocol/asset pair is indexed before migrating capital.

gates.title: Share price history available
gates.description: At least one share price snapshot exists so withdrawal pricing can be reproduced after migration.
gates.guidance: Backfill share-price snapshots from the indexer; the deterministic fixture is not sufficient evidence for a production migration.

gates.title: Backend healthy
gates.description: The backend serving vault data reports a healthy readiness state.
gates.guidance: Resolve any degraded signals before running the migration window.

gates.title: Deposits available
gates.description: The deposit path is not blocked by vault capacity, missing stats, or an unhealthy backend.
gates.guidance: A migrated vault should accept deposits on day one; unblock any action gating before promoting the new vault.

gates.title: Withdrawals priced and available
gates.description: The withdraw path can price shares from share-price history and is not gated by an unhealthy backend.
gates.guidance: Verify withdrawals can be priced immediately after migration so users are never locked out of positions.
